warming_air.label: Air warming (recent baseline)
warming_air.description: Air temperature anomaly recorded at 2 meters above the surface for 2025 relative to the 1979-1988 average.

warming_vs_preindustrial_air.label: Air warming (pre-industrial)
warming_vs_preindustrial_air.description: Air temperature anomaly recorded at 2 meters above the surface for 2021-2025 relative to the 1850-1900 pre-industrial baseline.

warming_sst.label: Sea-surface warming
warming_sst.description: Sea-surface temperature anomaly for 2025 relative to the 1982-1991 average.

precipitation_trend.label: Annual precipitation trend
precipitation_trend.description: Trend in annual total precipitation (mm/year) from 1979 to 2025; blue = wetter, yellow = drier. Note: ERA5 precipitation trends may be inflated by changes in the satellite observing system over time.

reef_stress.label: Coral heat-stress trend
reef_stress.description: Trend in annual coral heat stress (DHW risk score) from 1985 to 2025; higher values indicate faster increases.

june_2026_heatwave.label: June 2026 heat anomaly
june_2026_heatwave.description: Air temperature in June 2026 relative to the 1991–2020 June average. Red = hotter than normal, blue = cooler.

heatwave_2026_w1.label: Jun 20–22 · Iberia
heatwave_2026_w1.description: Air temperature over 20–22 June 2026 relative to the 1991–2020 June average, as the heat dome built over the Iberian Peninsula.

heatwave_2026_w2.label: Jun 23–25 · France
heatwave_2026_w2.description: Air temperature over 23–25 June 2026 relative to the 1991–2020 June average, as the heat peaked over France and the Low Countries.

heatwave_2026_w3.label: Jun 27–29 · Central Europe
heatwave_2026_w3.description: Air temperature over 27–29 June 2026 relative to the 1991–2020 June average, as the heat peaked over Central Europe and Italy.

heatwave_2026_w4.label: Jul 6–10 · Second episode
heatwave_2026_w4.description: Air temperature over 6–10 July 2026 relative to the 1991–2020 July average, as a second episode built over France and Iberia. Still rising at the July 10 data cutoff.
